name: TypeScript
certifications: No vendor certification; assessed by capstone project
OpenJS Node.js Application Developer (JSNAD) for Node.js work

beginner.summary: Assumes basic JavaScript (variables, functions, arrays). Participants learn the TypeScript type system, compiler setup, typing functions, objects and classes, modules and async code, and type a small Node.js application from scratch.
prerequisites: Writes simple JavaScript: variables, functions, arrays and objects
Can use a terminal and install Node.js
Has used a code editor such as VS Code
outcomes: Set up and configure TypeScript projects
Type functions, objects, classes and async code correctly
Use unions, narrowing and generics in everyday code
Build and test a small typed Node.js application

days.topic: TypeScript Setup, the Compiler and First Program
subtopics: Compiling a project and watch mode
Reading type errors in VS Code
Type errors do not stop JavaScript output by default
days.lab_task: Create a TypeScript project with tsconfig.json, write a program that prints a formatted invoice, compile it to a dist folder, run it with Node and then run the source directly with tsx.
days.deliverable: Project folder with tsconfig.json, source, compiled output and terminal logs
checks: Pass a string where a number is expected
tsc reports the error with file and line
Enable noEmitOnError and compile with an error

subtopics: string, number, boolean, bigint and symbol
any and why to avoid it
days.lab_task: Convert a provided 150-line JavaScript file into TypeScript with strict mode on, adding annotations only where inference is not enough and fixing every error the compiler finds.
days.deliverable: Converted file, list of real bugs found by the compiler and the clean compile output
checks: Report the bugs the compiler found
At least two real bugs explained
objectives: Rely on inference where it is clear

days.lab_task: Write a typed utility module with functions for formatting money, parsing dates, debouncing a callback and an overloaded find function that returns one item or a list depending on the argument.
days.deliverable: Utility module with type-checked usage examples
checks: Compile error: string is not assignable to number
Call the overloaded find with an id and with a filter
Return types are an item and an array
Pass a callback with the wrong parameters to debounce
Compile error on the callback parameter types

days.topic: Object Types, Interfaces and Type Aliases
days.lab_task: Model a shop's products, customers and orders with interfaces and type aliases, including optional fields, readonly IDs and an order that extends a base entity.
days.deliverable: Model types and a sample data file that type-checks
checks: Create an order missing a required field
Explain one choice of interface over type alias

days.lab_task: Model payment results as a discriminated union of success, declined and error, handle each in a switch with an exhaustiveness check, and write a type predicate for validating API data.
days.deliverable: Payment handling module and tests
checks: Add a new payment result kind
Access a success-only field without narrowing
Validate a malformed object with the predicate

subtopics: Union of string literals as an alternative
Deriving a union from an object with keyof typeof
days.lab_task: Define order statuses three ways (enum, literal union and as const object), compare the compiled JavaScript, and build typed event names with template literal types.
days.deliverable: Three implementations, compiled output comparison and recommendation
checks: Participant shows which forms produce runtime code
Derive the status union from the const object

days.lab_task: Build a bank account class hierarchy with an abstract base class, private balance, a savings account that adds interest and a class that implements a Statement interface.
days.deliverable: Class code and usage examples
checks: Read the private balance from outside
Call the abstract method on the base class
Compile error: cannot create an instance of an abstract class
Pass a savings account where a Statement is expected

days.lab_task: Write a generic typed cache, a generic paginate function and a getProperty function that only accepts keys of the object passed in.
days.deliverable: Generic utilities with type-checked examples
checks: Store a number in a Cache<string>
Compile error: number is not assignable to string
Call getProperty with a key that does not exist
Compile error: key is not in keyof the object

days.topic: Arrays, Objects and Built-in Utility Types
subtopics: Typed array methods: map, filter, reduce
Using utility types for update payloads
days.lab_task: Write create, update and summary functions for products where the create input omits the id, the update input is partial and the summary is a Pick, all derived from one Product type.
days.deliverable: Typed functions and examples

days.topic: Maps, Sets and Iterating Typed Collections
subtopics: Typed lookups that may be undefined
days.lab_task: Build a typed inventory report that groups products by category in a Map, finds duplicate SKUs with a Set, and prints totals per category without any type assertions.
days.deliverable: Report source and output for the sample data
checks: Run the report on the sample data
Category totals match the answer file
objectives: Use Map and Set with types

days.lab_task: Split the shop code into models, services and utils modules with path aliases, use type-only imports for types, and make it run under Node with ES modules.
days.deliverable: Restructured project and run output
checks: Run the compiled project with Node
Inspect compiled output for a type-only import
Resolves in tsc and at runtime

subtopics: async functions and their return types
await and error handling with try/catch
days.lab_task: Write a typed client that fetches users and their posts from a public test API in parallel, times out after three seconds and returns partial results when one request fails.
days.deliverable: Client source and output for success, timeout and partial failure

days.topic: Working with JSON and Validating External Data
subtopics: Why type assertions do not validate data
days.lab_task: Validate API responses and a config file with Zod schemas, infer TypeScript types from the schemas, and show that an invalid response produces a readable error instead of a crash later.
days.deliverable: Schemas, inferred types and error output
checks: Load a response with a missing field
Readable Zod error naming the field
Load a config with a string port

days.lab_task: Refactor the API client so network, validation and not-found failures are distinct error classes, return a Result type from the public function and log errors with their cause.
days.deliverable: Refactored client and output for each failure type
checks: Returns a Result with a ValidationError
Access error.message in a catch without narrowing
objectives: Choose between exceptions and Result types

days.topic: Typing the DOM and Browser APIs
days.lab_task: Build a typed to-do web page with Vite that adds, completes and filters tasks, saves them in localStorage and handles form events without any use of any.
days.deliverable: Vite project and a recorded demo
checks: Use a wrong event type in a handler
Production bundle builds with no type errors
objectives: Build a browser app with Vite

days.topic: Linting and Formatting with ESLint and Prettier
subtopics: npm scripts for lint and format
days.lab_task: Add typescript-eslint with type-checked rules and Prettier to the shop project, fix every finding, and add a pre-commit hook that blocks unformatted or failing code.
days.deliverable: Lint configuration, clean lint output and the hook configuration
checks: Hook reformats or blocks the commit

subtopics: Writing tests with describe, it and expect
days.lab_task: Write Vitest tests for the utilities and API client, mocking fetch, covering every error path and adding type tests that check the inferred return types.
days.deliverable: Test suite and coverage report
objectives: Test types as well as values

days.topic: Node.js Scripts and CLI Tools in TypeScript
subtopics: Running with tsx and building with tsc
days.lab_task: Build a typed CLI that scans a folder of CSV files, validates rows with Zod, writes a summary JSON report and exits with a non-zero code when any file is invalid.
days.deliverable: CLI source, sample report and exit code demo
checks: Run against the valid sample folder
Add a file with a bad row
Exit code 1 and the row is named

days.topic: Building a Simple REST API with Express and TypeScript
subtopics: Typing request params, query and body
Running in development with tsx watch
days.lab_task: Build a typed products API with list, get, create and delete routes, Zod validation, a central error handler and Supertest tests for each route.
days.deliverable: API source and route tests
checks: POST a product with a missing name

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Typed Expense Tracker Application
days.lab_task: Build an expense tracker with typed domain models, Zod validation, JSON file storage, monthly summaries by category, a CLI or REST interface, full tests and a clean lint run, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Project repository, test report, lint output and a 10-minute demo
checks: Add an expense with a negative amount
Totals per category match the test data
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one application

intermediate.summary: For people who write TypeScript but mostly with simple types. Covers advanced type features, type-safe API design, strict configuration, typed React and Node.js back ends, monorepos, testing and publishing libraries.
prerequisites: Writes TypeScript daily with interfaces, unions and generics
Has built a small Node.js or browser application
outcomes: Use conditional, mapped and template literal types
Design type-safe APIs shared between front end and back end
Build typed React and Node.js applications
Structure, test and publish TypeScript packages

days.topic: Strict Compiler Options and Safer Configuration
subtopics: Migrating a codebase to stricter flags gradually
days.lab_task: Turn on noUncheckedIndexedAccess and exactOptionalPropertyTypes in a provided project, fix the errors in batches, and record the real bugs each flag uncovered.
days.deliverable: Updated tsconfig, fixed code and a bug log
checks: Read an array element without checking it
At least three real bugs found

days.lab_task: Write a typed event emitter where on and emit only accept registered event names and payloads, and a pipe function that infers types through five transformations.
days.deliverable: Event emitter and pipe utilities with type tests
checks: Emit an event with the wrong payload
Compile error on the payload argument
Compile error on the event name

days.lab_task: Write types that unwrap nested promises, extract the element type of arrays, get the return type of async functions and pick only the function properties of an object.
days.deliverable: Type library with expectTypeOf tests
checks: Pick function properties of a class type
Apply a distributive type to a union

subtopics: Modifiers: readonly and optional, adding and removing
days.lab_task: Build types that generate getter names for an object, make a configuration deeply readonly, and create a form-state type with a value, error and touched flag for every field.
days.deliverable: Type library and examples
checks: getName and getAge exist with correct types
Assign into a deep readonly config
Add a field to the form model

days.topic: Template Literal Types and String Manipulation Types
days.lab_task: Write a type that extracts parameter names from a route string such as "/users/:id/posts/:postId" and use it to type a router function's params object.
days.deliverable: Router types and examples
checks: Params are inferred with no extra code

days.topic: Type Guards, Assertion Functions and the satisfies Operator
subtopics: Guards for arrays and unknown JSON
days.lab_task: Write guards and assertion functions for incoming webhook payloads, and use satisfies on a route configuration so it is checked against a type while keeping its literal key types.
days.deliverable: Guard library, configuration file and type tests
checks: Call assertIsOrder on a bad payload
Throws with a message naming the field
Narrowed to Order with no cast
Add an unknown key to the satisfies config
Compile error on the extra key
objectives: Check values with satisfies without widening

days.topic: Type-Safe API Design Between Front End and Back End
subtopics: Sharing types in a common package
Contract-first with OpenAPI and generated types
Dates and serialisation across the wire
days.lab_task: Build the same small API twice, once with OpenAPI-generated client types and once with tRPC, then change a field and show where each approach reports the break.
days.deliverable: Two implementations and a comparison note
checks: Rename a field on the server
Client compile fails in both versions
Client receives the agreed type, not a raw string

days.topic: Typed Node.js Back Ends with Fastify or NestJS
subtopics: Project structure for a typed service
Fastify type providers with JSON Schema or Zod
days.lab_task: Build a products service in Fastify or NestJS with validated configuration, typed request schemas, a central error handler and graceful shutdown.
days.deliverable: Service source and test results
checks: Fails at startup with a clear message

days.topic: Databases with Prisma or Drizzle ORM
days.lab_task: Add PostgreSQL storage to the products service with Prisma or Drizzle, including migrations, a relation to categories, a transaction for stock changes and tests against a database in Docker.
days.deliverable: Schema, migrations, data access code and tests
checks: Query a product with its category

days.topic: Authentication and Authorisation in Typed APIs
subtopics: Password hashing with argon2 or bcrypt
Typing the authenticated user on requests
Role and permission checks as typed helpers
days.lab_task: Add sign-up, login and refresh to the products service, type the current user on every request, restrict delete to admins with a typed permission helper and test every rule.
days.deliverable: Auth code and security tests
checks: Delete a product as a normal user
Call a protected route without a token
Try eleven wrong passwords in a minute
objectives: Authenticate users in a typed API

days.lab_task: Build a typed product admin screen with a generic table component, a reducer for filters, a typed context for the current user and form events with no use of any.
days.deliverable: React project and screenshots
checks: Pass a column key that the row type lacks
Compile error on the column key
Compile error on the action type

days.topic: Data Fetching and State Management with Types
subtopics: Loading and error states as unions
days.lab_task: Connect the admin screen to the products API with TanStack Query, add an optimistic update with rollback, and keep UI state in a typed store.
days.deliverable: Updated React project and hook tests
checks: Make the update fail on the server
UI rolls back to the old value
Use a query result before checking loading state

days.topic: Monorepos with npm Workspaces and Project References
days.lab_task: Put the API, React app and shared types in a pnpm monorepo with project references and Turborepo, so changing shared types rebuilds only what depends on them.
days.deliverable: Monorepo structure and build logs
checks: API and web both rebuild and type-check
Import web code from the API

days.topic: Declaration Files and Typing Third-Party JavaScript
days.lab_task: Write a declaration file for a small untyped JavaScript library, augment Express's Request type with a user property, and generate declarations for your own package.
days.deliverable: Declaration files and type tests
checks: Call the untyped library with wrong arguments

days.lab_task: Write a method decorator that logs timing, a validation decorator for class fields and a caching decorator, then compare them with plain higher-order functions.
days.deliverable: Decorators and comparison note

subtopics: Contract tests between API and client
days.lab_task: Add integration tests for the API with a real PostgreSQL container and Playwright end-to-end tests for the admin screen, and fail the run below 80 percent coverage.
days.deliverable: Test suites and CI-ready scripts
checks: Admin flow passes in a headless browser

days.lab_task: Build a small library with tsup to ESM and CommonJS with declarations and source maps, and set up the app build so bundling and type-checking run separately and in parallel.
days.deliverable: Build configuration and output folders
checks: Import the library from an ESM and a CommonJS project
Type-check step fails though bundling succeeds
Breakpoints map to the TypeScript source

subtopics: Checking exports with publint and arethetypeswrong
README and API documentation with TypeDoc
days.lab_task: Prepare the library for publishing with a correct exports map, changesets for versioning, export checks and TypeDoc documentation, then publish to a local Verdaccio registry.
days.deliverable: Package configuration, generated docs and registry listing
checks: Types work in a consuming project

days.lab_task: Measure type-checking of a slow provided project, find the two most expensive types with a trace, simplify them and show the time saved.
days.deliverable: Diagnostics before and after and the trace analysis
checks: Check time at least 30 percent lower

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Full-Stack Typed Product Catalogue
days.lab_task: Build a product catalogue in a monorepo with a typed API, PostgreSQL storage, a React admin, shared contracts, unit, integration and end-to-end tests and a cached CI build, then present it.
days.deliverable: Monorepo, test reports and a 15-minute demo
checks: Rename a field in the shared contract
Back end and front end fail to compile until updated
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one product

advanced.summary: For senior TypeScript developers. Covers type-level programming, compiler internals and the compiler API, large-codebase architecture, migrations, performance, security, observability and running TypeScript services and libraries in production.
prerequisites: Writes advanced generics, conditional and mapped types
Has built and shipped full-stack TypeScript applications
Maintains a medium or large TypeScript codebase
outcomes: Write and test type-level code for libraries
Use the compiler API for custom tooling
Architect and migrate large TypeScript codebases
Run fast, secure and observable TypeScript services in production

subtopics: Recursive types and tail recursion limits
Opaque types for IDs and money
days.lab_task: Build branded types for UserId, OrderId and Money that cannot be mixed, and a phantom-typed builder that only allows build() after all required fields are set.
days.deliverable: Type library with type tests
checks: Pass an OrderId where a UserId is expected
Compile error: OrderId is not assignable to UserId
Call build() before setting the required fields
Compile error: build does not exist on the incomplete builder
Branded types add no runtime code

days.topic: Type-Safe Domain Modelling and State Machines
days.lab_task: Model an order workflow from draft to paid, shipped, delivered or cancelled so that invalid transitions do not compile, and implement it with XState and typed events.
days.deliverable: Domain model, state machine and tests
checks: Send an event the machine does not accept in its state
Every unhandled place is reported by the compiler

subtopics: Typed errors with Result and Either
The Effect library basics of use
When the functional approach is worth it
days.lab_task: Rewrite one service call chain with Effect so every possible error is in the type, dependencies are injected through context and retries and timeouts are declarative.
days.deliverable: Rewritten module, tests and a trade-off note
checks: Swap the database for a test layer
objectives: Judge when to adopt effect systems

subtopics: Compiler architecture: scanner, parser, binder, checker, emitter
Walking and querying a source file
days.lab_task: Write a ts-morph codemod that renames a deprecated function across a project and updates its arguments, and a script that lists every exported function with its resolved return type.
days.deliverable: Codemod, report script and before and after diffs
checks: Run the codemod on the sample project
All call sites updated and the project compiles
objectives: Read and change code with the compiler API

days.topic: Custom ESLint Rules with Type Information
days.lab_task: Write two custom rules: one that bans awaiting inside loops where Promise.all would do, and one that uses type information to forbid passing raw strings where a branded ID is expected, with fixes and tests.
days.deliverable: ESLint plugin with tests
checks: Lint the sample with an await in a loop
All valid and invalid cases pass

days.lab_task: Restructure a provided tangled codebase into feature modules with public entry points, enforce the boundaries automatically and record the main decisions in ADRs.
days.deliverable: Restructured code, boundary rules and ADRs
checks: Import a module's internal file from another feature

subtopics: JSDoc types as a first step
Communicating the migration to a team
days.lab_task: Migrate a provided 40-file JavaScript service in stages: checkJs with JSDoc, conversion of core modules, then strict mode, measuring type coverage at each stage.
days.deliverable: Migration plan, staged commits and type coverage report
checks: Run the service after each stage
Measure type coverage at the end
Add new any to a converted file

days.lab_task: Load-test the products service, find an event-loop block and a memory leak with clinic.js and heap snapshots, move CPU work to worker threads and show the throughput gain.
days.deliverable: Profiles before and after and load test results
checks: Requests per second at least doubled
p99 delay below 50 ms after the fix

subtopics: Typed forms with React Hook Form and Zod
days.lab_task: Build a typed design-system Button that is polymorphic, a compound Tabs component and a form whose fields, validation and submit types all come from one Zod schema.
days.deliverable: Component library and examples
checks: Render Button as a link without href
Submit the form with invalid data
Field errors shown and no submit
Form types update and misuse fails to compile

days.lab_task: Build a Next.js app with server components reading from Prisma, validated server actions, typed environment variables and authentication, then create a production build.
days.deliverable: Next.js project and production build output
checks: Submit a server action with invalid data

days.topic: GraphQL with TypeScript: Generated and Code-First Types
days.lab_task: Build a GraphQL API for products and categories with typed resolvers, fix an N+1 problem with DataLoader, generate typed client hooks and block an over-deep query.
days.deliverable: GraphQL server, generated types and client example
checks: Generated client code fails to compile
Send a query nested ten levels deep

days.lab_task: Add a typed job queue for order emails with retries and a dead-letter queue, publish order events to Kafka with versioned schemas, and push live order updates to the browser over WebSockets.
days.deliverable: Queue, event and WebSocket code with tests

subtopics: OWASP Top 10 for Node.js and web apps

days.deliverable: Fixed code, security tests and CI configuration
checks: Inject a script into a product name
Rendered as text and blocked by CSP

days.lab_task: Instrument the API and the queue worker with OpenTelemetry and pino, follow one order through both in the tracing tool, and send errors with source-mapped stack traces to Sentry.
days.deliverable: Instrumentation code, trace screenshot and dashboard

Throw an error in production mode
Sentry shows the TypeScript source line
All lines for the request are found

days.lab_task: Build a small production image for the API with a multi-stage build, handle SIGTERM correctly, then deploy the same handler to AWS Lambda and compare cold starts.
days.deliverable: Dockerfile, deployment configuration and comparison table
checks: Stop the container during a request

subtopics: Pipeline stages: install, type-check, lint, test, build
Remote caching with Turborepo or Nx

days.deliverable: Workflow files and pipeline timing results
checks: Run the pipeline a second time

subtopics: Overloads versus generics for public functions
days.lab_task: Design a small validation library API, track its public surface with API Extractor, test types on two TypeScript versions and make a breaking change visible in the report.
days.deliverable: Library, API report and type tests
checks: API Extractor report shows the change
Run type tests on two TypeScript versions
Use the library in a sample app

subtopics: Mock Service Worker for network mocking
days.lab_task: Add property-based tests to the pricing logic, mutation-test it with Stryker to above 80 percent, mock the network with MSW for front-end tests and shard Playwright runs.
days.deliverable: Test suites, Stryker report and timing results
checks: Finds or rules out edge-case failures

days.topic: Production Troubleshooting for Node.js and TypeScript
subtopics: Reading production stack traces with source maps
days.lab_task: Work through three injected production incidents (a crash loop from an unhandled rejection, a memory leak and a slow query), restore service, find root causes and write runbooks.
days.deliverable: Incident timelines, fixes and runbooks

subtopics: Load test, demo and design defence
